title: Clean up the runtime-error tail: encoded-backslash URLs (/join%5C, /discover/spaces%5C) return a 500 instead of a 404, and the space-campaigns cron hit its 300 s limit on 11-12

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: Vercel runtime errors: "Cannot find module ./.next/server/pages/join%5C.js" count 2 (last 2026-11-09) and /discover/spaces%5C count 2; "Task timed out after 300 seconds" on /api/cron/space-campaigns (last 2026-11-12), despite the 100-item cronBudget in app/api/cron/space-campaigns/route.ts.

WHY IT MATTERS: Bots and mistyped links get a 500 that Sentry counts as an error; one campaign cron run died mid-batch, so a scheduled Space email could resend or slip.

FIX DIRECTION: Redirect or 404 paths ending in an encoded backslash in proxy.ts; lower the per-run campaign budget or time-box the send loop so it ends before 300 s.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
